title: LAKE RUN — the first New York growhouse
dek: Green Rush reaches +$98 a second in Market 2 while Mike checks in from Lake Nacimiento, California.
body:
The live Green Rush run is in New York, Market 2 of 17. Today’s threshold was $18K: the first Boutique Growhouse is open, lifting automatic cash from $30 to $98 a second and starting flower at 2.5 units a second.

The verified post-purchase snapshot: six products found, one upgrade installed, six active operations across four types, and $24.3K lifetime revenue on the road to the $1M next-market license.

Mike’s at Lake Nacimiento in California. The empire is earning while the lake holds still.

Free browser game, no signup, and no real products sold.
